english.note: Use this when adding further information or appending a remark to what was said.

examples.english: I’ll add one thing: remember to bring an umbrella.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 bou2 cung1 jat1 geoi3 gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1

english.note: Use 補充 when replenishing something so that it remains full or adequate.

examples.english: The water is all gone, so we need to supply more before there is enough.
examples.traditional: 啲水飲晒喇，要補充返先夠用。
examples.jyutping: di1 seoi2 jam2 saai3 laa3 jiu3 bou2 cung1 faan1 sin1 gau3 jung6
